Name: Home Shopping and Fast Travel
Author: EleanorWilde
Description:
HOME SHOPPING AND FAST TRAVEL — PUBLIC BETA

F7 — In your farmhouse, choose a shopkeeper to open their normal shop. Prices and stock are unchanged. Remote shopping is available from 6:30 AM until 9:00 PM in-game, subject to shop availability. Goods only; no construction or tool-upgrade services.

F8 — Travel to selected places you have previously visited, such as the beach, mine entrance, or railroad. Return to your farmhouse from away. Selected Stardew Valley Expanded shops and locations are supported if installed and visited. No story unlocks are granted.

Installation: Install SMAPI 4.5.2 or later. Unzip into Mods and launch through SMAPI. Use F7/F8 when you can move freely. The in-game menu is in Simplified Chinese.

Testing: Built and checked offline against Stardew Valley 1.6.15 and SMAPI 4.5.2 on Windows. Live shopping, travel, and multiplayer are not yet verified. Please include the shop or destination and your SMAPI log when reporting an issue.

居家购物与快速传送｜公开测试版
F7：在自己的农舍按键，选店主购物。商品、价格和库存不变。游戏时间 06:30 至 21:00 前可用，仍受营业条件限制。不提供施工或工具升级服务。
F8：传送到已到访的指定地点，也可以回农舍。部分 SVE 地点和商店可用。不会跳过剧情解锁。
安装：安装 SMAPI 4.5.2 或更新版本，将 ZIP 解压到 Mods 文件夹，通过 SMAPI 启动。已离线核对；尚未实测购买、传送或联机。

AI disclosure / AI 说明: Codex generated most of the C# code and helped create the listing and preview. The animation is an illustrated guide, not gameplay footage. 主要代码由 Codex 生成，动图为操作示意。
